analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price($1.57) vs SMA5($1.46)/SMA20($1.40)/SMA50($1.32): Confirmed above short- and mid-term trends.
· High position relative to SMA100($1.19)/SMA200($1.27): Indicates strong mid- to long-term trend.
· 52-week position (27.5%) + Recovery from historical low range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (46.3→67.4): Exited oversold, entering upper neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0216→0.0132): Continued improvement, signaling bullish expansion.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near upper band $1.53): Approaching upper band, band width expanding to 19.80%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($1.53): Based on BB middle band and prior highs.
· Swing resistance ($1.60): Psychological resistance, potential for further upside on breakout.
· 5-day high($1.58)/low($1.29), 20-day high($1.58)/low($1.25): Higher Low pattern confirmed, strengthening trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.76x): Surge, increasing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend): 3 consecutive days of gains, meeting buy entry conditions.
